users.title: Users

users.deactivateBody: They'll be signed out everywhere and won't be able to sign in. Their records are kept.

import.title: Import students
import.description: Bring existing students and guardians in from Excel or a CSV file. Nothing is saved until you review and confirm.
import.step1Body: Start from the template, or use your own spreadsheet. Columns can be in any order and named your own way: you match them to Whizchool fields in step 3.
import.excelTip: In Excel, save with File → Save As → “CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)” so Sinhala and Tamil names keep their letters.
import.notCsv: Please choose a .csv file. In Excel use File → Save As → CSV UTF-8.
import.empty: The file has no data rows below the header row.
import.noHeader: The first row must hold the column names, such as First Name and Class.
import.tooBig: The file is larger than 5 MB. Split it into smaller files.
import.tooManyRows: The file has {count} rows. Import at most {max} at a time.
import.encodingNote: This file wasn't saved as UTF-8, so letters outside English may look wrong. If names look garbled, save it again as “CSV UTF-8”.
import.mapBody: We recognised {matched} of {total} columns. Check each match, and choose what any other column contains.
import.duplicate: {field} is chosen for more than one column. Keep it on one.
import.invite: Email parent-portal invitations to guardians with an email address
